<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Correction:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty extended losses for a fourth consecutive session, closing over 1% lower as surging crude oil prices and a sharp decline in IT stocks dragged the Nifty below 23,450.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Liquidity Management:</strong> The RBI is reportedly utilizing dollar swaps to drain a record ₹11 trillion banking cash glut to maintain stability in the financial system.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxPMUE2QTA3MWdacWFJVjlrcWg4RUllREd6czFlM0hKSzVaWjdxdXl2VWkyNTdISGdzbDI3QW5raV9xb0E2WkN0amxCUmtzVnljZHZFcGoyX21YYUw4SlNRZ01teWdoTXZxcWI5XzdfWDdhMTVYcDZiSVljbWFrWUFicnRJbmFacUtUbUg3ZmdhemNqeW16TUlOM0d1TQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a></span></li>

</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
